zh: 量子旋钮 这些数在经典版里是写死的常数
en: Quantum knobs in the classical edition these numbers are hard-wired constants

zh: 经典的弗里德曼方程只认"密度"。密度从哪来、热的开端里发生了什么、扰动的种子多大——都由下面的量子物理决定。每个旋钮旁写着它进入方程的方式。
en: The classical Friedmann equation only knows "density". Where the density comes from, what happened in the hot beginning, how big the seeds of the perturbations were — all of that is decided by the quantum physics below. Next to each knob is the way it enters the equations.

zh: 辐射与重子
en: Radiation and baryons

zh: 今天的背景温度 $T_0$
en: Background temperature today $T_0$

zh: 普朗克黑体公式：$\Omega_\gamma h^2 = 2.47\times10^{-5}\,(T_0/2.7255\,\mathrm{K})^4$ → $\Omega_r$ = （取代了经典版的 $\Omega_r$ 滑杆）
en: Planck's black-body formula: $\Omega_\gamma h^2 = 2.47\times10^{-5}\,(T_0/2.7255\,\mathrm{K})^4$ → $\Omega_r$ = (replaces the $\Omega_r$ slider of the classical edition)

zh: 相对论性中微子种数 $N_{\mathrm{eff}}$
en: Number of relativistic neutrino species $N_{\mathrm{eff}}$

zh: 费米–狄拉克统计：$\Omega_r = \Omega_\gamma(1 + 0.2271\,N_{\mathrm{eff}})$；也加快核合成时的膨胀
en: Fermi–Dirac statistics: $\Omega_r = \Omega_\gamma(1 + 0.2271\,N_{\mathrm{eff}})$; also speeds up the expansion during nucleosynthesis

zh: 重子 $\Omega_b$
en: Baryons $\Omega_b$

zh: 重子-光子比 $\eta = n_b/n_\gamma$ = （对数刻度；不能超过 $\Omega_m$）
en: Baryon-to-photon ratio $\eta = n_b/n_\gamma$ = (log scale; cannot exceed $\Omega_m$)

zh: 原初涨落（暴胀）
en: Primordial fluctuations (inflation)

zh: 扰动幅度 $A_s$
en: Perturbation amplitude $A_s$

zh: 暴胀子的量子涨落 $\delta\phi = H/2\pi$ 留下的功率谱幅度；$\sigma(M)\propto\sqrt{A_s}$
en: Amplitude of the power spectrum left by the inflaton's quantum fluctuations $\delta\phi = H/2\pi$; $\sigma(M)\propto\sqrt{A_s}$

zh: 谱指数 $n_s$
en: Spectral index $n_s$

zh: < 1：小尺度涨落相对更弱（红谱）；= 1：尺度不变
en: < 1: small-scale fluctuations relatively weaker (red spectrum); = 1: scale invariant

zh: 张标比 $r$
en: Tensor-to-scalar ratio $r$

zh: 原初引力波的份额，定暴胀能标：$V^{1/4} = (3\pi^2 A_s r/2)^{1/4} M_{Pl}$；观测 $r<0.03$
en: The share of primordial gravitational waves; sets the energy scale of inflation: $V^{1/4} = (3\pi^2 A_s r/2)^{1/4} M_{Pl}$; observed $r<0.03$

zh: 基本常数（核合成与复合）
en: Fundamental constants (nucleosynthesis and recombination)

zh: 精细结构常数 $\alpha/\alpha_0$
en: Fine-structure constant $\alpha/\alpha_0$

zh: 氢的电离能 $13.6\,\mathrm{eV}\propto\alpha^2$，汤姆孙截面 $\sigma_T\propto\alpha^2$：定复合和光子退耦的时刻
en: Hydrogen's ionization energy $13.6\,\mathrm{eV}\propto\alpha^2$, Thomson cross-section $\sigma_T\propto\alpha^2$: sets when recombination and photon decoupling happen

zh: 电子质量 $m_e/m_{e,0}$
en: Electron mass $m_e/m_{e,0}$

zh: 电离能 $\propto m_e$，汤姆孙截面 $\propto 1/m_e^2$；也进弱作用的相空间
en: Ionization energy $\propto m_e$, Thomson cross-section $\propto 1/m_e^2$; also enters the phase space of the weak interaction

zh: 中子–质子质量差 $Q$
en: Neutron–proton mass difference $Q$

zh: MeV。冻结时 $n/p = e^{-Q/T}$，又定中子寿命（相空间 $\propto Q^5$）
en: MeV. At freeze-out $n/p = e^{-Q/T}$; also sets the neutron lifetime (phase space $\propto Q^5$)

zh: 弱作用强度 $G_F/G_{F,0}$
en: Weak-interaction strength $G_F/G_{F,0}$

zh: n↔p 的速率 $\propto G_F^2$，中子寿命 $\propto 1/G_F^2$：定 n/p 何时冻结 → 中子寿命 $\tau_n$ =
en: n↔p rate $\propto G_F^2$, neutron lifetime $\propto 1/G_F^2$: sets when n/p freezes out → neutron lifetime $\tau_n$ =

zh: 量子引力（可选）
en: Quantum gravity (optional)

zh: 圈量子宇宙学的反弹
en: Loop-quantum-cosmology bounce

zh: 有效方程 $H^2 = \tfrac{8\pi G}{3}\rho\,(1-\rho/\rho_c)$：密度到 $\rho_c$ 时收缩翻成膨胀，奇点消失。理论值 $\rho_c\approx0.41\,\rho_{\mathrm{Planck}}$（滑杆最右）；拉低它，反弹就发生在看得见的地方
en: Effective equation $H^2 = \tfrac{8\pi G}{3}\rho\,(1-\rho/\rho_c)$: when the density reaches $\rho_c$, contraction flips into expansion and the singularity disappears. Theoretical value $\rho_c\approx0.41\,\rho_{\mathrm{Planck}}$ (slider fully right); lower it and the bounce happens where you can see it

zh: 量子旋钮全部复位
en: Reset all quantum knobs

zh: 锁死的常数：ħ、c、G（只定单位）、ΛQCD、希格斯真空期望值、暗物质的粒子性质。
en: Locked constants: ħ, c, G (they only fix the units), ΛQCD, the Higgs vacuum expectation value, the particle properties of dark matter.
